title: Completed-tensor Roos chain maps respect scalar towers
statement: For finite coefficient fields E,L,F over Q_l with maps iota:E→L and j:L→F, every scheme W and arbitrary cochain complexes P,Q of completed E-coefficient modules, the explicit completed tensor chain comparison [lem-pur-integral-scalar-finite-comparison-models] satisfies S_j(delta_iota(P,Q));delta_j(S_iota P,S_iota Q);T_F(kappa_P,kappa_Q) = kappa_(T_E(P,Q));delta_(j iota)(P,Q), where kappa is the termwise scalar associator of [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition].

source.place: Tensor reassociation, evaluation and coefficient comparisons; scalar-comparison proof step 9 of lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension; Stacks 03EL, 07A4, 08J9 and 08TC.

proof.text: Use the strict tensor tower composition equation of the new proved tower-composition lemma. It is obtained from the finite scalar tensor calculation componentwise using the chosen tower normalization.

Apply additiveRoosComposite to the ordinary scalar functors S_i,S_j,S_ji and the scalar associator. Take a to be the i tensor tower comparison, b the j comparison followed by the tensor tower map on the two associators, and c the direct comparison. The preceding strict tower equation supplies its hypothesis.

Unfold the normalized chain comparison and tensor complex functor, and use functoriality of the strict Roos map on b. The resulting equation, with associativity of composition and the mapped-isomorphism hom formula, is exactly the statement.

theorem integralScalarTensorChainTower (W : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) :
    ((integralOrdinaryScalar l L F j W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        (scalarTensorChain l E L ι W P Q) ≫
      scalarTensorChain l L F j W
        (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≫
      (integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor l F W).map (CategoryTheory.Prod.mkHom
        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι W F j)
          (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)
        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι W F j)
          (.up ℤ)).hom.app Q)) =
    (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralOrdinaryScalarComp l E L ι W F j)
      (.up ℤ)).hom.app ((integralOperationsTensorComplexFunctor l E W).obj (P, Q)) ≫
        scalarTensorChain l E F (j.comp ι) W P Q
